observed_human_evidence: Fresh ChatGPT conversation responded by merely echoing/rendering `Prometeo P-ZM-01` and did not execute the durable JOB.
root_cause: A completely fresh/unprimed ChatGPT conversation has no guaranteed built-in meaning for the token `Prometeo`; external GitHub state cannot cause that fresh chat to fetch the stable entry unless the first message itself contains a resolvable bootstrap locator or the platform has a native/global Prometeo integration.
prevention_rule: Until a native/global account-level Prometeo resolver exists, every guaranteed fresh-chat launch must be self-bootstrapping: include the stable entry URL in the first message together with the optional Home/job selector. Bare `Prometeo` remains valid only for chats already primed/bound or environments that already know the Prometeo convention.
